definitions.explanation: A formal way to say 'today,' commonly used in business settings, announcements, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}は{ご来店|ごらいてん}ありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for visiting our store today.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}の{会議|かいぎ}は{中止|ちゅうし}になりました。
{本日|ほんじつ}より{新|しん}サービスを{開始|かいし}いたします。
examples.english: We will begin our new service starting today.

notes:
REGISTER: Formal

{本日|ほんじつ} is the formal equivalent of {今日|きょう}. It is commonly used in:
・Business communications
・Store announcements
・Formal speeches
・Written notices

SIMILAR:
・{今日|きょう} (today - neutral/casual)
・{本日|ほんじつ} (today - formal)
